goal: Verify that a user can create a new Site Host account and successfully navigate the calendar view from the initial month to a future month using the navigation controls.

findings.instruction: From the May 2026 view, click the 'Next month' button (right arrow) three consecutive times to advance the calendar to September 2026.
findings.title: Calendar navigation advanced only two months instead of three
findings.description: The instruction required clicking the 'Next month' button three times to reach September 2026 from May 2026. However, the calendar now displays August 2026, indicating only two successful advances occurred. This breaks the expected navigation flow.
findings.evidence: Before screenshot shows 'May 2026'. After screenshot shows 'August 2026'. Three clicks should have resulted in 'September 2026' (May -> June -> July -> September).
reproduction_steps: Navigate to the calendar view showing May 2026.
Click the 'Next month' button three consecutive times.
Observe that the calendar displays August 2026 instead of September 2026.
